intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按“避开 Nigel -> 假装没用 -> persistent 性格 -> 想办法阻止跟随 -> 礼貌请求带来压力 -> 牙医借口失败”的故事线跟读。重点读清 avoid meeting, It was no use pretending, No matter how, insists on coming, preventing him from following, Would you mind my coming 和 waiting room 的笑点。

sentences.text: I crossed the street to avoid meeting him, but he saw me and came running towards me.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：我穿过马路想避开遇见他，但他看见了我并朝我跑来。注意 avoid meeting 的 doing，后半句 came running towards me 要读出动作链。

sentences.text: It was no use pretending that I had not seen him, so I waved to him.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：再假装没看见已经没用了，所以我向他招手。It was no use 后面接 pretending，so I waved to him 是无奈但礼貌的动作。

sentences.text: No matter how busy you are, he always insists on coming with you.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：不管你多忙，他总是坚持要跟你一起去。No matter how busy 先让步，always insists on coming 读出反复习惯。

sentences.text: I had to think of a way of preventing him from following me around all morning.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：我得想办法阻止他整个上午跟着我。a way of preventing 和 from following 都要接 doing，around all morning 读出被缠住的时间感。

sentences.text: 'Hello, Nigel,' I said. 'Fancy meeting you here!'
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：你好，Nigel，真没想到在这儿遇见你。Fancy meeting you here 是口语惊讶，语气要自然，不要读成正式作文句。

sentences.text: 'Would you mind my coming with you?' he asked, before I had finished speaking.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：还没等我说完，他就问我是否介意他一起去。Would you mind my coming 是礼貌请求，before I had finished speaking 读出时机太急。

sentences.text: 'Not at all,' I lied, 'but I'm going to the dentist.'
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：没关系，我撒了个谎，但我要去看牙医。Not at all 很短，I lied 要轻轻落下，dentist 两个音节，重音在前。

sentences.text: 'Then I'll come with you,' he answered. 'There's always plenty to read in the waiting room!'
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：那我也跟你去，候诊室里总有很多东西可读。Then I'll come with you 读出 Nigel 的开心，plenty to read 是笑点。
